title: Basket Credit on Limit-Review Claims: Cartwise Grocery Orders Cases
content:
## Basket credit on limit-review claims: cases

Cartwise Grocery Orders adds a basket credit last to the limit-review claim amount, after that amount has been rounded to the cent. The credit turns on the order's billed item lines and its item subtotal:

- when the order has **at least 5** billed item lines and an item subtotal (the sum of its billed item lines) of **at least 50.00**, the credit is **0.75**;
- when it has at least 5 billed item lines and an item subtotal **below 50.00**, it is **0.50**;
- otherwise there is none.

Billed item lines are counted from the order's billed item line charge entries; the item subtotal is the total of those entries' amounts.

### Cases (all hypothetical)

| Case | Billed item lines | Item subtotal | Basket credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 5 | 50.00 | 0.75 |
| B | 5 | 49.99 | 0.50 |
| C | 12 | 180.40 | 0.75 |
| D | 4 | 96.00 | none |
| E | 1 | 12.00 | none |

**Case B in full.** An order with 5 billed item lines totalling 49.99 falls just under the subtotal line, so its credit is 0.50; one more cent of billed items would have carried it to 0.75.

**Case D in full.** Four billed item lines leave the order short of the line count, and the credit is none whatever the subtotal.
